Alternatives to the Instant Cold Brew? 
I know this is very divisive product and I am unfortunately a lover of it. The instant cold brew grounds are my favorite, I was buying 2 per shop. Now I am aware they are off the shelves, and my store specifically shared that, according to their system, the item is “not orderable”. I just finished the last of what I bought back in September so I really need to find a replacement. I make cold brew and do not like it at all, and I don’t enjoy hot coffee that becomes iced coffee for some reason… this is a me problem, I know! But anyway, do you guys have any dupes for this product? Or an instant coffee that can be made with ice water?
